lines: Greetings, professor! The valley's soil is vibrant today.
Looking for fresh seeds or ready to sell your bountiful harvest?
A refreshing rain for the crops! It saves us the watering work today.
Step inside out of the wet and see what seeds we have in store.
Ah, my favorite botanist! Your dedication to this valley has been truly inspiring.
I've been preparing some special herbal blends for our next project!
Ah, welcome to the valley! It's wonderful to meet a fellow botanist.
Take some seeds, till the rich soil and see what sprouts!
By the Great Oak! You actually synthesized a brand new hybrid species?!
I knew your biology background would bear fruit! What other impossible combinations might exist?
Incredible! You have discovered nearly every botanical anomaly in the valley!
The Haven is truly alive thanks to your botanical research.
